title: NTLM Handshake Timeout Exception in Adjudication Service
description:
Error: Connection timed out after 30000ms during NTLM handshake with legacy directory services.

Stack trace indicates TCP connection reset by peer during negotiation phase. Need to implement jittered exponential backoff and retry policy.

title: Update RBAC Clearance Cache for ChromaDB Retrieval
description: Ensure metadata filters (clearance <= user_level) apply cleanly to all vector similarity queries before document chunks are returned to the LLM.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion under Peak Traffic
description:
Issue: SQLite connection handles are not being returned to the pool during concurrent FastAPI worker requests.
Remediation: Set check_same_thread=False and implement a connection lease timeout manager.

title: Zero-Egress Proxy Filter Gateway Implementation
description: As a Compliance Officer, I want all outbound network requests from the AI Agent pipeline blocked at the kernel/socket level so that proprietary code and PHI cannot egress to external cloud APIs.

title: ChromaDB Embedding Dimension Mismatch on Document Ingest
description: Error: ValueError: Embedding dimension 384 does not match collection dimension 768 when running text chunker against security policy docs.

title: Implement Jittered Exponential Backoff for REST Gateway
description: Added Tenacity retry handlers around all HTTP requests with exponential backoff and random jitter to mitigate transient 500/503 errors.

title: Migrate Legacy AD Authentication to Kerberos / NTLM v2
description: Enterprise infrastructure team is deprecating NTLM v1. We must migrate all internal service-to-service connectors to Kerberos or NTLM v2 with session signing.

title: LangGraph Node State Persistence across Worker Restarts
description: Implement SQLite/MemorySaver checkpointing in LangGraph StateGraph so long-running multi-agent runs can be audited and resumed on transient worker crashes.

title: Memory Leak in Persistent SQLite Connection Pool
description: Cursor objects were not closed in try...finally blocks, causing gradual RAM buildup. Fixed by adopting context managers for all database connections.

title: Audit Logging for Level 3 Clearance Document Retrieval
description: Whenever a user or agent queries confidential documents (Clearance Level 3), an immutable audit event must be logged with timestamp, user ID, and query embeddings.

title: SLA Breach on Adjudication Batch Pipeline
description: Incident: Batch claim processing time exceeded the 15-minute SLA threshold due to lock contention in the status table during concurrent batch updates.

title: Implement Pydantic v2 Schema Validator for TFS Payloads
description: Created WorkItemSummary model to filter away internal system GUIDs and URL blobs from raw Azure DevOps JSON payloads.
